question: Can KL geometry regularization, tangent-noise regularization, or both prevent rank-1 constrained DAS from specializing to the temporal answer/foil readout while retaining its scalar advantage?

authority.finding: unregularized cDAS beats DIM on sealed scalar loss but loses on centered full-vocabulary causal-effect fidelity

frozen_design.fit: 16 even A1 rows only; odd A1 and all A2 remain sealed evaluation
frozen_design.checkpoint: lowest unperturbed training objective checked before fitting and every 10 updates plus the final update; DIM is always a feasible retained baseline
frozen_design.scalar_objective: normalized answer/foil exact-match squared error plus normalized complement-inertness squared error
frozen_design.kl_objective: scalar objective plus normalized KL(exact full logits || subspace full logits) plus normalized KL(base full logits || complement full logits), weight 1
frozen_design.noise_objective: scalar objective trained on an antithetic pair of rank-1 tangent perturbations of size 0.05; unperturbed checkpoints
frozen_design.kl_noise_objective: KL objective trained on the same deterministic antithetic tangent perturbations

predictions.pred_a_authority_closure_baseline_reprod: q=I closure <=1e-4, frozen DIM/unregularized reports reproduce within 0.01, all fits finite, and exact registered execution accounting closes
predictions.pred_b_kl_noise_repairs_full_vocabulary_: KL+noise full-vocabulary joint objective is below both unregularized cDAS and DIM on heldout A1 and A2
predictions.pred_c_kl_noise_retains_scalar_advantage: KL+noise scalar joint objective remains below DIM on heldout A1 and A2
predictions.pred_d_noise_alone_reduces_readout_overf: noise-only full-vocabulary joint objective improves at least 10% over unregularized cDAS on heldout A1 and A2
predictions.pred_e_regularized_restarts_are_identifi: minimum pairwise absolute cosine across starts is at least 0.80 for each regularized objective

terminal_rules.objective_regularized: A-C and E pass but D fails; KL geometry repairs the target while noise alone does not
terminal_rules.stability_regularized: A, C-E pass but B fails; noise helps scalar generalization without recovering full vocabulary geometry

interpretation: Noise tests row/local-minimum memorization; KL tests specialization to a narrow readout. They are not interchangeable explanations.
